$comment: The one source of Vivechak's evidence definition (grades, modifiers, verification methods, rules). The server reads it for vivechak://methodology/grades; `go run ./tools/docgen` renders it into FRAMEWORK.md §5.1-§5.3, the generators' CORE blocks, skills/vivechak/SKILL.md, templates/rules/*, README.md and docs/QUICKSTART.md (with their internal/embed twins). Edit this file, then run go run ./tools/docgen.

grades.label: Primary Empirical
grades.description: Official specifications, canonical source code, RFCs, or primary documentation with explicit URL anchor.

grades.label: Secondary Empirical
grades.description: Peer-reviewed papers, reproducible third-party benchmarks, published postmortems, or corroborated engineering reports.

grades.label: Vendor & Practitioner
grades.description: Vendor marketing, product whitepapers, vendor benchmarks, conference talks, or interested-party documentation.

grades.label: Informal & Opinion
grades.description: Blog posts, forum discussions, StackOverflow answers, or model memory recall (capped at Grade D).

grades.label: Speculative & Unsubstantiated
grades.description: Unverified hypotheses, uncorroborated parametric recall, or ungrounded assertions.

modifiers.name: Directness
modifiers.purpose: Does this apply to our case?

verification.definition: Retrieved and validated live via tool/web call during this session
Read from local repository file or previously verified artifact
Generated from model parametric memory without live verification
Sourced from an article summarizing a primary source
Injected directly by a human engineer

rules: Parametric memory recall is capped at **Grade D**.
Grade A requires canonical URL or specification anchor.
